title: Ring Just Ended Its Controversial Partnership With Flock Safety
summary: Ring announced it has ended its planned partnership with Flock Safety, which would have let law enforcement request Ring footage through FlockOS/Flock Nova. Ring says the integration never launched and no footage was transferred. The cancellation follows backlash to Ring's 'Search Party' Super Bowl ad and renewed privacy concerns tied to Flock's data being accessible to ICE.

key_quotes.quote: On Friday, Ring published a blog post announcing the end of its relationship with Flock Safety.
Ring says that since the integration never actually launched, no user footage was ever sent to Flock Safety
they were likely fueled by reporting from 404 Media that ICE has been able to access Flock Safety's data in its investigations
